scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && jest --config jest.integration.config.js; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && jest --config jest.e2e.config.js; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v
scripts.test:integration:only: bash -c 'docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && jest --config jest.integration.config.js -t "$0"; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v'
scripts.test:e2e:only: bash -c 'docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && jest --config jest.e2e.config.js -t "$0"; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v'
